description: Remove the `if (submitted) return "already accepted…"` guard in runAgent's submit, so later submits are validated and can replace the accepted plan.

edits.find: if (submitted) return "already accepted. You are done; stop here.";

description: Remove the `if (submitted) return "already accepted…"` guard in runAgent's submit, so submits after acceptance are validated.

edits.find: if (submitted) return "already accepted. You are done; stop here.";

description: In runAgent, rethrow the agent's failure before returning the accepted submission, as it did before 9c61b29, so a throw after acceptance loses the plan.

edits.find:
if (submitted) return submitted;
  if (failure) throw failure;
edits.replace:
if (failure) throw failure;
  if (submitted) return submitted;
